content.value: An HMAC-signed `POST` fired to subscribers on every publish event — the push half of Barkpark's contract with downstream readers.

alone) matches no subscriber and nothing is sent.

The headline subscriber is the Web Demo's receiver, which turns a publish event into Cache Revalidation — calling
